model_bounds_scope: Fitted prediction functions only; reference error-invariance assumption remains unvalidated.
limitations: Sensitivity scenarios in supplied coordinates, not measured assay errors. All boxes are intersected with target support for nondefects, chemical upper caps and nonnegative identity-coordinate defects. Only fitted Stale predictions are bounded; style labels across the entire box and physical outcomes are not certified.
Forest sum-of-leaf extrema can be conservative because different trees need not attain their maxima together.
Failure of a conservative bound does not prove that any point violates the model guard.
No label uncertainty, causal error, mass balance or fermentation constraints are included.
